description: The tool that checks C# source code and translates it into a form the .NET runtime can execute; a program runs only once it compiles.
A problem the compiler reports before anything runs, with a `CS` code, a file position and a message, such as `CS1002: ; expected`.
Statements written directly in a file, outside any class, that run from top to bottom when the program starts.
A named place that holds a value of one fixed type; its value can change, its type cannot.
A keyword that lets the compiler infer a variable's type from the value assigned to it; the type is still fixed at compile time.
A number type that stores decimal digits exactly, used for money and written with the `m` suffix, as in `19.99m`.
Division of two whole-number values, which drops the fraction, so `7 / 2` is `3`; cast one side to `double` to keep it.
A string that starts with `$`, in which each `{expression}` is evaluated and inserted as text.
